payload.title: Candidate filter so extraction stops proposing common words
payload.description: publish_run.py has no stoplist, part-of-speech or document-frequency filter, which is how 'attachments', 'shows' and 'material' became concepts. Read config/stop-words.txt and config/vocabulary.yml from the state bucket, and filter before AI review. No fixed caps: thresholds learned from the corpus or stated as a site setting.
